headline: RBC Downgrades Equifax Rating Citing Mortgage Sector Weakness
summary: RBC lowered its equity rating on consumer credit reporting agency Equifax, pointing to ongoing weakness in mortgage volume activity.
why: Equifax is one of the big three credit reporting bureaus in the US, deriving substantial revenue from mortgage credit inquiry checks.

impacts.name: Equifax
impacts.why: Analyst downgrades citing persistent mortgage market softness reduce investor confidence in revenue growth prospects.

why_moved: Analyst downgrades pointing to macroeconomic headwinds in core lending markets typically put downside pressure on equity values.
